notes.title: Idol VS Furries
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Available on September 15[/h1][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579020/Idol_VS_Furries/

Idol VS Furries is a third-person shooter.
In a stylized style !

Earn skins for your character,
by completing missions in the game's 3 different maps. (In 3 Countries)
The maps are all linked by portals.

Take advantage of the ability to grind on pipes to move from one map to another.

Fight the Furries
They'll drop different types of loot when you defeat them, such as:
Health packs, Weapons, Money, Gear to buy weapons, and energy crystals to be able to take portals.

There's also a no-fight mode so you can enjoy the game environment without pressure.
(You don't need energy crystals to move from one portal to another in this game mode.)

A total of 11 differents weapons are available.

Have fun !

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
- A new level is available on the left of the blue portal in the central hub.
- Spawn Problem Fix
- You can pick up a potion and use her when you want with an animation;
the camera will be free during the animation.
- The number of potions available is displayed on the screen 
- You have a default potion in addition to the ones you can loot from your enemies
- Potions also have a higher drop rate

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
- AIs now have a chance to drop healing potions
-Juggernaut scale reduce for take less space on the screen

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Frozen Staff :
-The camera moves a little higher for better comfort when playing with this weapon.
-Animation of walking with the Frozen Staff Fix
-Then returns to normal with the Unicorn weapon.
-When a player tries to cast the spell without having the necessary amount.
This made the spell unusable even after the mana was restored. Fix

-The character's feets don't fit in the ground anymore.

-The spider AI's have been reduced in size, taking up too much screen space.
-The main menu music has been changed
-Adding music to the hub
-Adds footstep and jump-land noises

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Update #1 :

- The walk animation was not in sync with the player speed now it is fix.

- Speaking of speed, a new sprint animation has been added. 
It is a more dynamic than the previous one. With a little camera effect.

- In the Relaxing Mode there was still some AI that we have now removed,
so that you can enjoy this mode in peace.

- Now you can pause the game when you open the options menu.

- Tutorial widgets pause the game too. And activates only once unlike before.

- As a reminder, the "Coliseum Mode" is available from the main menu of the game.

notes.title: Coliseum Mode
